request.prompt:
Create a complete 6-second Korean cafe dialogue, revision 4. The most important change is the woman's CONNECTED pronunciation of "아니그게". Use the NEW audio reference as her pronunciation and voice guide. This reference replaces all older female recordings.

최우선 연기 지시: 여자의 "아니그게" 네 음절을 약 0.37초 안에 하나의 덩어리로 붙여 말한다. "아니" 뒤에서 멈추거나 숨을 쉬거나 말끝을 내리지 않는다. "니"에서 곧바로 "그"로 이어진다. "아니"를 독립된 감탄사처럼 강조하지 않는다. 자연스럽고 빠른 한 호흡으로 "아니그게 고민이 된다고?"라고 묻는다. 마지막 "된다고?"는 짧고 분명하게 올라가는 의문형이다.

REFERENCE ROLES
Image 1: approved research-campus cafe, woman left and man right, warm wood table, two mugs, phone, blue chairs, soft daylight.
Image 2: same woman's face, early-thirties Korean researcher, shoulder-length dark-brown hair, ivory blouse, navy blazer.
Image 3: same man's face, early-thirties Korean R&D engineer, short black hair, clean-shaven, oatmeal-grey knit sweater.
One audio reference: ONLY the woman's question "아니그게 고민이 된다고?" with her established voice. Use its rapid connected opening. It contains no male speech. Do not add pauses or stretch its syllables. Her other lines have the same vocal identity.
The man speaks fluent native Seoul Korean with a warm, natural low-mid baritone and grounded chest resonance. Preserve this lower-tone direction; no foreign accent, nasal thinness or artificial bass.

EXACT SPOKEN WORDS — EACH ONCE
Woman: "너 이번에 소음진동학회 가?"
Man: "음, 아직 고민 중."
Woman: "아니그게 고민이 된다고?"
Woman: "딱 일 분만 들어봐."

PACING AND SHOTS
0.00–1.65: medium two-shot, woman immediately asks her first line while looking at the man. "소음진동" is compact and connected, first syllable "소" short, not stretched.
1.70–2.55: hard cut to man's close-up. He answers quickly, a very short "음" and no long thinking pause.
2.60–4.10: hard cut to woman's close-up. At 2.60–2.97 she says the WHOLE "아니그게" as one connected rapid unit. Immediately continue "고민이 된다고?" in the same breath. Her eyebrows rise with a crisp upward question ending on "고?". No breath, break, dramatic pause, emphasis reset or vowel extension between "아니" and "그게". The new audio's connected opening is the pronunciation guide.
4.15–5.35: same shot, woman says the final line quickly and confidently.
5.35–6.00: brief natural smile and end.
BOTH speakers retain brisk conversational delivery with tiny turn-taking gaps. Their bodies move at normal speed. No slow narration.

They are old friends talking to each other, never presenting to camera. Preserve the approved faces, clothes, lighting, cafe and table objects. Realistic synchronized mouth movements; listener's mouth still. Small gestures. Clear Korean dialogue and very quiet cafe ambience. No music, extra dialogue, subtitles, writing, logos or title cards. 16:9 cinematic everyday realism.
